shortDescription: Introduced a new enhancement to the Provider page that separates key metrics by In-Network and Out-of-Network provider statuses.
body:
Release Notes: Disruption September 18, 2025

The Network360 Team is excited to share the latest updates designed to enhance your experience on the Disruption platform.



What’s New in This Release?

We’ve introduced a new enhancement to the Provider page that separates key metrics by In-Network and Out-of-Network provider statuses, which results in the three key highlights given below.   



Key Highlights:



1. Segregated Metrics for In-Network and Out-of-Network Providers

What’s New:

Metrics on the Provider Page are now split into two distinct sections—In-Network and Out-of-Network—based on provider status.

o	In-Network: Includes providers with statuses such as Added, Retained, Manually Matched.

o	Out-of-Network: Includes providers with statuses like Dropped, N/A.



How This Helps:

This separation gives users a clearer view of how each provider group contributes to overall utilization and financial impact, enabling more targeted network optimization.





2. Dynamic Metric Display Based on Availability

What’s New:

The top card on the Provider Page now dynamically displays the most relevant Count and Amount metrics based on available data.

The new card at the top-right of the Provider Page displays: 

o	Utilization Count (e.g., Visits, Claims, Claimants, Procedures)

o	Dollar Amount (e.g., Paid, Billed, Allowed)



How This Helps:

Users always see the most meaningful metrics without manual interaction, improving usability and reducing confusion when certain data points are unavailable.



3. Real-Time Updates on Network Selection

What’s New:

When a user selects a network, the metrics in the top card update instantly—no page reload required.



How This Helps:

This allows users to quickly compare network performance without interrupting their workflow.



Conclusion

This enhancement to the Provider Page makes it easier for users to analyze network performance and understand the financial and utilization impact of their decisions. By separating In-Network and Out-of-Network metrics, highlighting key data, and validating accuracy, it helps users make faster, smarter choices with confidence.

For more details, please don’t hesitate to reach out!
